purpose: Fresh, traceable comparison of EPR scheduling policies. Historical result folders are inputs for audit only and are never silently reused as golden-study data.

model_scope.excluded_claim: This study does not claim native end-to-end entanglement swapping or data-qubit relay storage unless a separately versioned trace-v2 experiment implements it.
model_scope.latency_metric: request eligibility to EPR delivery, including admission wait, reservation, retries, and generation; excluding cached-pair storage before eligibility
model_scope.makespan_metric: wall-clock simulator completion time after the workload completes

workloads.rule: Every workload, placement, route, and trace must be explicitly registered with relative paths and SHA-256 digests before execution.

seeds.rule: Seed lists are intentionally empty until approved. A final run requires disjoint non-empty training and evaluation physics seed lists and a non-empty mapping seed list.

memory_experiment.compiler_memory_allocations: enumerate every integer allocation from 0 through total_memories_per_core - 1 for policies that use compiler reservations; on-demand uses 0 by definition

classification.6,8,16,32,64: architecture-scaling sensitivity settings; never report as the current physical hardware setting

routing.rule: A routing comparison reuses one immutable placement contract. Every route is exported before ACE execution and validated for endpoint replay, adjacency, topology, and hash.

mapping.new_experiments: T-HQA with explicitly recorded initial-placement configuration
mapping.rule: Mapping and routing are never varied in the same causal comparison.

acceptance_rules: completion_rate must equal 1.0 for every accepted run
all compared policies must use the same trace hash and paired physics seeds
a result must include a Git SHA, source hashes, configuration hash, and raw-output paths
every report figure must cite its source CSV and be accompanied by a numeric table
screening and final evaluation results must be labelled separately
